input.summary: Extend the licence to contractors acting on our behalf and permit transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We extended the grant to contractors acting on our behalf alongside our affiliates, and added a right to transfer the licence to a successor of our business in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets, so a corporate transaction does not require Garman's consent. Our playbook treats affiliate/contractor coverage and successor transferability as baseline licence terms; the balance of Section 3(c) and Section 20(d) consent requirements is unchanged.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors acting on Sparkling's behalf, in each case operating at Authorized Locations, a non-exclusive licence, transferable to a successor to Sparkling's business by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, to use

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing;

ops.oldText: without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement to a successor to its business by way of merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets.
